questions.question: Three partners P, Q and R invested a total of Rs. 52,000 in a business. At the end of the year, P got Rs. 1430, Q got Rs. 1870 and R got Rs. 2420 as the share of profit. How much amount did Q invest in the business?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio P : Q : R = 1430 : 1870 : 2420 = 13 : 17 : 22.

Total Profit units = 13 + 17 + 22 = 52 units.

Since time is constant, Investment Ratio = Profit Ratio.

52 units = Rs. 52,000 ⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 1,000.

Q investment = 17 units × 1,000 = Rs. 17,000.

**∴ The correct option is C.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total investment = Rs. 52,000

Profit of P = Rs. 1430, Profit of Q = Rs. 1870, Profit of R = Rs. 2420

**Formula Used:**

Investment Ratio = Profit Ratio (When time period of investment is same for all partners)

 Profit Ratio Analysis

 Total Units = 52 = Rs. 52,000

**Calculations:**

Profit Ratio P : Q : R = 1430 : 1870 : 2420

⇒ P : Q : R = 143 : 187 : 242 (Dividing by 10)

⇒ P : Q : R = 13 : 17 : 22 (Dividing by 11)

Sum of ratio parts = 13 + 17 + 22 = 52

⇒ Q’s Investment = (17 / 52) × 52000

⇒ Q’s Investment = 17 × 1000

⇒ Q’s Investment = Rs. 17,000

**∴ The correct option is C.**

Simple Partnership

When investments are for the same duration, Profit₁ : Profit₂ = Capital₁ : Capital₂.

Compound Partnership

questions.question: A person lent certain sum of money at the annual rate of 5 percent on simple interest. In 4 years, the interest amounted to Rs. 800. What is the sum lent?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In **Simple Interest**, the interest percentage is the product of **Rate** and **Time**.

Total Interest % = 5% × 4 = 20%

⇒ 20% of the **Sum lent** = ₹800

⇒ 100% of the **Sum lent** = 800 × (100 ÷ 20) = 800 × 5 = ₹4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Simple Interest** (SI) = ₹800

**Rate** of interest (R) = 5% per annum

**Time** (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b6da2286951809fdccf1d75de5f70798c12f13c980668e42177665209622c56.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 800 = (P × 5 × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ 800 = (P × 20) ÷ 100

⇒ 800 = P ÷ 5

⇒ P = 800 × 5

⇒ P = ₹4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100. This assumes the interest is not added back to the principal.

Total Amount

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI). In this case, A = 4000 + 800 = ₹4800.

Rate and Time Relationship

If the Rate is doubled and the Time is halved, the **Simple Interest** remains unchanged as the product R × T stays constant.

__
 
• **Leaching is the process by which water-soluble inorganic nutrients present in the topsoil get washed down into the lower soil horizons and get precipitated as unavailable salts.**
 
• This process occurs due to** excessive rainfall or irrigation,** which causes the excess water to percolate through the soil and carry the nutrients with it.
 
• The nutrients that are commonly leached from the topsoil include nitrates, phosphates, and potassium, which are essential for plant growth.
 
• However, when they accumulate in the lower soil horizons as salts, they become unavailable to plants and can even cause soil salinization if the concentration becomes too high.

• ** Fragmentation:** It refers to the breakdown of organic matter into smaller particles by physical or biological processes. It does not directly affect the leaching of nutrients.
 
• ** Humification**: It is the process of decomposition of organic matter into humus, which is a stable form of organic matter that improves soil fertility. It does not directly affec**t the leaching of nutrients.**
 
• Decomposition: It refers to the breakdown of organic matter into simpler compounds by microorganisms. It can release nutrients into the soil, but it does not directly affect the leaching of nutrients.
